summary: Backend regression passed 6/6. USER001 login, hidden slot navigation, direct /slots restriction, officer dashboard, request duration/live corridor status, slot results, and slot reuse navigation passed. CSV export was not completed because the UI test exposed a missing navigation selector; code review identifies an auth issue in the export implementation.

integration_issues.issue: Dashboard CTA uses window.history.pushState instead of React Router navigation; React location state is not updated, so clicking the CTA can leave the dashboard rendered at /new until another navigation occurs.
Export uses window.open(/api/reports/export) without attaching the bearer token stored in localStorage. The protected endpoint will return 401 in a fresh browser request.

action_items: Implement authenticated CSV download using an axios/blob request or make export authentication consistent with the frontend flow.
Retest CSV download after authentication fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Protected report export is opened as a new unauthenticated request, so the visible CSV action is likely broken despite the API passing with Authorization.
Dashboard CTA bypasses React Router state management.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (restricted access and officer planning flows pass; CSV unverified and two integration issues identified)

seed_data_creation: Regression tests created TEST_regression pending records; no cleanup endpoint was available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest dashboard CTA and authenticated CSV download. USER001 restriction and officer slot/request flows are passing.
rca of the issue: App.js Dashboard uses window.history.pushState, which changes the URL without notifying BrowserRouter. Blocks export opens the protected API URL directly, while the API requires a Bearer header and does not receive localStorage tokens in a new tab request.
